skill.name: marketing-demand-acquisition
skill.description: Plan multi-channel demand generation for B2B SaaS teams. Covers paid media, SEO, partnerships, HubSpot tracking, attribution, and CAC analysis.
skill.summary: Build acquisition plans, channel playbooks, and CAC reports for B2B SaaS growth teams.

security_audit.summary: All static findings appear to be false positives from Markdown code fences, inline examples, marketing terms, and campaign diagrams in SKILL.md. No evidence of command execution, reconnaissance intent, prompt injection, network calls, secret access, or data exfiltration was found in the reviewed files.

content.value_statement: Series A teams need fast campaign plans, channel benchmarks, and reporting workflows. This skill provides demand generation playbooks, CAC calculations, and HubSpot-ready acquisition guidance.
actual_capabilities: Builds campaign briefs for LinkedIn, Google, Meta, SEO, and partnerships.
Defines HubSpot campaign tracking, UTM structures, lead scoring, and attribution reports.
Provides paid media playbooks with targeting, budget allocation, bid strategy, and creative guidance.
Creates SEO plans covering technical audits, keyword tiers, on-page templates, and link acquisition.
Calculates blended and channel CAC with the included Python calculator.
Outlines partnership, affiliate, co-marketing, and sales handoff workflows.
limitations: It provides strategy and templates, not direct access to ad platforms or HubSpot.
Benchmarks are generic and need validation against actual account data.
The CAC calculator uses example data unless the user edits inputs.
Legal and privacy guidance still requires review for each market.

use_cases.title: Launch a Multi-Channel Campaign
use_cases.description: Create a campaign brief with audience, offer, budget, channel mix, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Optimize Paid Acquisition
use_cases.description: Plan LinkedIn, Google, and Meta campaigns with targeting, bid strategy, creative tests, and CAC benchmarks.

use_cases.title: Build Partner-Sourced Pipeline
use_cases.description: Design affiliate, referral, and co-marketing programs with tracking, enablement, and reporting steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign brief for a Series A B2B SaaS launch in the US. Include channels, budget, audience, offer, and SQL goals.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Paid Media Mix
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a paid media plan for LinkedIn and Google Search with a $40,000 monthly budget. Include targeting, campaign structure, benchmarks, and weekly scaling rules.

prompt_templates.title: Design SEO Expansion
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO and content roadmap for expanding from the US to Germany and France. Include technical tasks, keyword tiers, localization, and reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Build Acquisition Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an acquisition operating model for a hybrid PLG and sales-led motion. Include attribution, HubSpot dashboards, partnership tracking, experiments, and handoff SLAs.

output_examples.input: Plan a $40,000 acquisition mix for a Series A SaaS company.
output: A channel split across LinkedIn, Google, SEO, partnerships, tools, and experiments.
Expected MQL, SQL, CAC, and pipeline metrics for each channel.
Weekly optimization rules for scaling, pausing, and testing campaigns.

output_examples.input: Improve our HubSpot campaign tracking for EU and US campaigns.
output: A UTM naming structure for source, medium, campaign, content, and keyword fields.
Lead scoring guidance for campaign engagement and channel quality.
Attribution and dashboard recommendations for regional performance reviews.

output_examples.input: Prepare an affiliate program launch for a B2B SaaS product.
output: Partner tiers, commission options, recruitment channels, and enablement materials.
Tracking guidance for referral links, partner source fields, and monthly reports.
Launch steps for outreach, activation, and ongoing partner management.

best_practices: Start with clear SQL and CAC targets before selecting channels.
Validate every benchmark against your own funnel and sales cycle data.
Review campaign performance weekly and document experiment results.
anti_patterns: Do not copy benchmark budgets without checking market, ACV, and conversion rates.
Do not launch paid media without tracking, attribution, and handoff rules.
Do not treat affiliate volume as quality without pipeline and revenue validation.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for demand generation, paid media, SEO, and partnerships teams at B2B SaaS companies.

faq.question: Does it connect directly to HubSpot or ad platforms?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup guidance, naming structures, workflows, and reporting templates for those tools.

faq.question: Can it calculate CAC?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a local Python calculator for blended and channel-specific customer acquisition cost.

faq.question: Does it support international expansion?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers EU, US, and Canada considerations for localization, channels, compliance, and messaging.

faq.question: Can beginners use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates provide step-by-step campaign planning, tracking, and reporting guidance.

faq.question: What data should users provide?
faq.answer: Users should provide budget, target market, ACV, funnel metrics, sales motion, and current channel performance.
